I.status: NOT RUN (I2 to I5). Decision of the author on 2026-11-06 after the blocker below was reported; no LA7 code was written or run.

blocker.finding: LA7's single declared change (add a source-user frequency map as a model input) is already present in LA6.1: user_freq, the source-user frequency map, is model input column 3 of D1 and of LA6.1. LA7 as written is therefore the LA6.1 construction unchanged, and (c) would remain bit-identical to D1, contrary to LA7's declared consequence.

evidence.other_source_user_artefact: is_new_user (known-user set) would be constant on every fitting row, so it cannot enter a forest split (as is_new_src, constant in every LA6 fit: lanl_la6_controls.json fit/*/constant_features_on_fit_rows)

related_finding_11_8_1.text: 11.8.1 attributes '33 map entries changed and one destination computer dropped' to LA6.1 (86 labelled users). Those figures are LA6.2's (true label).
related_finding_11_8_1.action: none; per the author a correction amendment follows

H.bootstrap: 1000 resamples of source addresses with replacement, numpy Generator(PCG64(42)), the same resampled rows for (a) and every (a'); each scored against its own label; AUC ties averaged; difference AUC_a - AUC_a' recomputed per resample; 2.5/97.5 percentiles

J.rule: copied from stored JSONs; no refit, no rescoring. RBA May rows are L = (AUC_a - AUC_c) / (AUC_a - 0.5) applied to stored AUCs, because no JSON stores May L
J.flag_11_7_1: AUC_c < 0.5, or L > 1, or an interval bound on L > 1
J.domain_condition_11_2: lower bound of the 95% interval on AUC_a (AUC_a' for the controls) > 0.55; 'valid_share' is true only where it is satisfied
